0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons (3-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 14th in the East) in Emirates NBA Cup East Group A play, with Detroit coming off a one-game losing streak after going 3-1 over its last four. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) and is listing Egor Demin as day-to-day with a leg bruise and as a game-time decision. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, but the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
